result.title: Spatially-Aware Self-Organizing Graph Autoencoders via Localized Hebbian Learning
result.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the UBMK conference (not presented)
result.summary: Traditional autoencoders rely on static network architectures to learn latent representations. Recently we suggested a dynamic architecture inspired by Hebbian plasticity, enabling topological self-organization among convolutional feature maps (R. Koç et al., Proceedings of the SIU, 2026). Early implementations of this paradigm infer relationships among feature maps using global average pooling and model their interactions through scalar-valued connections. This approach falls short to fully exploit the underlying spatial information, embedded in input images. Furthermore, abrupt transitions between different loss functions and training dynamics can introduce representation shocks, leading to unstable feature learning. In this paper, we introduce a Spatially-Aware Self-Organizing Graph Autoencoder (S-LooM) to address these structural bottlenecks. By using spatial cross-correlation, and spatial kernels, S-LooM establishes dynamic connections among feature maps. We replace static scalar message passing of autoencoders with learnable spatial kernels and eliminate high-frequency deconvolutional artifacts observed in decoders using nearest-neighbor upsampling. Via a soft-blending training curriculum, the latent topology aligns smoothly during training. Our experiments show that S-LooM yields a more stable topology, compared to the state of the art dynamic architectures. Meaning, the graph structure that emerge has more resistance to feature entanglement and noise. It forms functional communities responsible for visual attributes, such as illumination, shape and texture even under high connection densities.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 S-LooM：用空间互相关与可学习空间核替代标量连接，在卷积特征图之间建立动态自组织图结构，并以最近邻上采样与软混合训练课程抑制表示抖动、稳定 latent 拓扑。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用空间核代替标量消息传递、让 latent 拓扑随训练自组织的做法，可能为 LVR 内部视觉细节保留与表示纠缠/坍缩问题提供方法线索，但论文不涉及推理与生成，迁移可行性有待核查。
